result.description:
The Central Statistics Office (CSO) is Ireland's national statistical office and our purpose is to impartially collect, analyse and make available statistics about Ireland’s people, society and economy.

Specifically, our mandate under the Statistics Act 1993 is "The collection, compilation, extraction and dissemination for statistical purposes of information relating to economic, social and general activities and conditions in the State".

At national level, CSO official statistics inform decision making across a range of areas including construction, health, welfare, the environment and the economy. At European level they provide an accurate picture of Ireland’s economic and social performance and enable comparisons between Ireland and other countries.

The CSO is also responsible for coordinating the official statistics of other public authorities.

results.name: courts-service-purchase-orders-greater-than-20-000-2026

notes_translated.en:
Purchase orders valued at €20,000 or more raised by the Courts Service for goods and services. 

The dataset is published quarterly and provides details of relevant purchase orders and whether payment has been made.

 

Please note:

Withholding Tax may be deducted from payments where applicable. As a result, the amount ultimately paid may be less than €20,000.

A purchase order may have been raised but not yet paid. Where this applies, ‘N’ will appear in the Paid column.

The dataset covers purchase orders for goods and services. It does not include reimbursements, recoupable items or grant-in-aid payments.

Some purchase orders may be excluded where their publication would be precluded under Freedom of Information legislation.
notes_translated.ga:
1) Asbhainfear Cáin Shiarchoinneálach ó íocaíochtaí nuair is cuí agus dá réir sin d'fhéadfadh an íocaíocht titim faoi bhun €20,000.                
                
2) Cé go bhféadfadh Ordú Ceannaigh a bheith cruthaithe, b'fhéidir nár íocadh é fós. Sna cásanna seo beidh 'N' le feiceáil sa cholún ar dheis.                 
                
3) Cuimsíonn an tuarascáil íocaíochtaí as earraí agus seirbhísí. Ní áirítear leis aisíocaíochtaí, ítimí in-aisíoctha ná íocaíochtaí deontas i gcabhair.                
                
4) D'fhéadfaí roinnt Orduithe Ceannaigh a eisiamh dá gcuirfí cosc ar a bhfoilsiú faoin reachtaíocht um Shaoráil Faisnéise.
